hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/MEMORY.md"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Working memory from last session (MEMORY.md is the live delta; CLAUDE.md is canonical):\n\n" + .)}}' "$f"; fi; exit 0

{ cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; c=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); w=$(echo "$c" | grep -E '^.. (src/|supabase/)' || true); if [ -n "$w" ] && [ -z "$(echo "$c" | grep -E 'CLAUDE\.md' || true)" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage":"CLAUDE.md drift: you changed src/ or supabase/ without updating CLAUDE.md (§0). Use the claudemd-update skill."}'; fi; }; exit 0
